0022600018.text: The 76ers (4-1, 1st in the Atlantic) host the 2-3 Knicks (8th in the East) in the sixth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. Philadelphia is on a one-game winning streak, with a 2-1 home record and a 4-1 mark over its last five, while the Knicks are on a two-game streak. Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 106-100 win in New York on October 20, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 before the 76ers lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs. Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, and Tacko Fall are out for Philadelphia, and Jaylen Brown is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain and Karl-Anthony Towns is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and also a game-time decision.
